// The test driver of fmt-exprs: a replacement main.nra for a copy of selfhost/.
// `driver <file> [--width N] [--trailing none]` formats the top-level
// `const` declarations of a file with the real expression, pattern and type
// printers. A block is printed by copying its statements from the source.
// Used by TestSelfhostFmtExprs (selfhost_fmtexprs_test.go).
import * as Fs from "std/fs"
import * as Int from "std/int"
import * as Str from "std/string"
import * as Arrays from "std/array"
import * as Doc from "narrac/fmtdoc"
import { Doc as Document, Options } from "narrac/fmtdoc"
import * as Parser from "narrac/parser"
import * as Exprs from "narrac/fmtexprs"
import { Expr, Decl, Block, Pos, Stmt, FuncDecl } from "narrac/ast"
import { Trivia, getPosKey, getStmtPos } from "narrac/trivia"
import { Printer, Settings, withComments } from "narrac/fmtprinter"

function getOffset(source: string, position: Pos): int {
  const length = Str.length(source)
  let offset = 0
  let line = 1
  while (line < position.line && offset < length) {
    if (Str.byteAt(source, offset) == 10) {
      line = line + 1
    }
    offset = offset + 1
  }
  let column = 1
  while (column < position.column && offset < length) {
    offset = Str.nextChar(source, offset)
    column = column + 1
  }
  return offset
}

function printStubBlock(printer: Printer, block: Block): Document uses alloc {
  if (Arrays.length(block.statements) == 0) {
    return Document.Text("{}")
  }
  let lines: Array<Document> = []
  for (const statement of Arrays.values(block.statements)) {
    const start = getStmtPos(statement)
    const end = printer.trivia.ends[getPosKey("s", start)]
    if (end is Some(endPos)) {
      Arrays.push(mutable lines, Document.HardLine)
      Arrays.push(mutable lines, Document.Text(Str.slice(printer.source, getOffset(printer.source, start), getOffset(printer.source, endPos))))
    }
  }
  return Document.Concat([Document.Text("{"), Document.Indent(Document.Concat(lines)), Document.HardLine, Document.Text("}")])
}

function isCompactValue(value: Expr): bool {
  return match (value) {
    Expr.BinaryExpr(_, _, _, _, _) => false
    Expr.IsExpr(_, _, _, _) => false
    _ => true
  }
}

function printFile(printer: Printer, parsed: Parser.Parsed): Document uses alloc {
  let parts: Array<Document> = []
  let first = true
  for (const declaration of Arrays.values(parsed.file.declarations)) {
    if (declaration is Decl.Const(constant)) {
      const key = getPosKey("d", constant.pos)
      if (!first) {
        Arrays.push(mutable parts, Document.HardLine)
        if (printer.trivia.blankBefore[key] is Some(_)) {
          Arrays.push(mutable parts, Document.HardLine)
        }
      }
      first = false
      let head: Array<Document> = [Document.Text(`const ${constant.name}`)]
      if (constant.type is Some(constantType)) {
        Arrays.push(mutable head, Document.Text(": "))
        Arrays.push(mutable head, Exprs.printType(printer, constantType))
      }
      Arrays.push(mutable head, Document.Text(" ="))
      const value = Exprs.printExpression(printer, constant.value)
      if (isCompactValue(constant.value)) {
        Arrays.push(mutable head, Document.Text(" "))
        Arrays.push(mutable head, value)
      } else {
        Arrays.push(mutable head, Document.Group(Document.Indent(Document.Concat([Document.Line, value])), -1))
      }
      Arrays.push(mutable parts, withComments(printer, key, Document.Concat(head)))
    }
  }
  Arrays.push(mutable parts, Document.HardLine)
  return Document.Concat(parts)
}

// ---- --check <width> <all|none> <file>: every expression of a statement is
// printed, read back as `const x = <text>` and printed again; the two texts
// must be equal.

struct Checker {
  width: int
  count: int
  failures: Array<string>
}

function createPrinter(source: string, trivia: Trivia, options: Options, trailing: bool): Printer {
  return Printer {
    source: source,
    trivia: trivia,
    settings: Settings { options: options, trailingComma: trailing },
    printExpression: Exprs.printExpression,
    printPattern: Exprs.printPattern,
    printType: Exprs.printType,
    printBlock: printStubBlock,
  }
}

function checkExpression(mutable checker: Checker, printer: Printer, expression: Expr, trailing: bool) uses alloc {
  const options = Options { printWidth: checker.width, tabWidth: 2, useTabs: false }
  const first = Doc.print(Exprs.printExpression(printer, expression), options)
  checker.count = checker.count + 1
  const source = `const x = ${first}\n`
  const reparsed = Parser.parseWithTrivia(source, 0)
  if (reparsed is Err(diagnostic)) {
    Arrays.push(mutable checker.failures, `reparse ${Int.toString(diagnostic.pos.line)}:${Int.toString(diagnostic.pos.column)} ${diagnostic.message} in: ${first}`)
    return
  }
  const #[tree, trivia] = reparsed.value
  if (tree.file.declarations[0] is Decl.Const(constant)) {
    const second = Doc.print(Exprs.printExpression(createPrinter(source, trivia, options, trailing), constant.value), options)
    if (second != first) {
      Arrays.push(mutable checker.failures, `unstable: ${first} -> ${second}`)
    }
  }
}

function checkBlock(mutable checker: Checker, printer: Printer, block: Block, trailing: bool) uses alloc {
  for (const statement of Arrays.values(block.statements)) {
    checkStatement(mutable checker, printer, statement, trailing)
  }
}

function checkStatement(mutable checker: Checker, printer: Printer, statement: Stmt, trailing: bool) uses alloc {
  if (statement is Stmt.BlockStmt(block)) {
    checkBlock(mutable checker, printer, block, trailing)
  } else if (statement is Stmt.VarStmt(_, _, _, _, _, _, value)) {
    checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, value, trailing)
  } else if (statement is Stmt.AssignStmt(_, target, value)) {
    checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, target, trailing)
    checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, value, trailing)
  } else if (statement is Stmt.ExprStmt(_, expression)) {
    checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, expression, trailing)
  } else if (statement is Stmt.ReturnStmt(_, Some(returned))) {
    checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, returned, trailing)
  } else if (statement is Stmt.IfStmt(_, condition, thenBlock, orElse)) {
    checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, condition, trailing)
    checkBlock(mutable checker, printer, thenBlock, trailing)
    if (orElse is Some(elseStatement)) {
      checkStatement(mutable checker, printer, elseStatement, trailing)
    }
  } else if (statement is Stmt.WhileStmt(_, _, condition, body)) {
    checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, condition, trailing)
    checkBlock(mutable checker, printer, body, trailing)
  } else if (statement is Stmt.ForStmt(_, _, _, _, iterable, body)) {
    checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, iterable, trailing)
    checkBlock(mutable checker, printer, body, trailing)
  }
}

function checkFunction(mutable checker: Checker, printer: Printer, declaration: FuncDecl, trailing: bool) uses alloc {
  if (declaration.body is Some(body)) {
    checkBlock(mutable checker, printer, body, trailing)
  }
}

function runCheck(path: string, width: int, trailing: bool): int uses io, alloc {
  const read = Fs.readText(path)
  if (read is Err(message)) {
    print(message)
    return 1
  }
  const parsed = Parser.parseWithTrivia(read.value, 0)
  if (parsed is Err(_)) {
    print("skip")
    return 0
  }
  const #[tree, trivia] = parsed.value
  const options = Options { printWidth: width, tabWidth: 2, useTabs: false }
  const printer = createPrinter(read.value, trivia, options, trailing)
  let checker = Checker { width: width, count: 0, failures: [] }
  for (const declaration of Arrays.values(tree.file.declarations)) {
    if (declaration is Decl.Func(func)) {
      checkFunction(mutable checker, printer, func, trailing)
    } else if (declaration is Decl.Const(constant)) {
      checkExpression(mutable checker, printer, constant.value, trailing)
    } else if (declaration is Decl.Test(testDeclaration)) {
      checkBlock(mutable checker, printer, testDeclaration.body, trailing)
    } else if (declaration is Decl.Impl(implementation)) {
      for (const method of Arrays.values(implementation.functions)) {
        checkFunction(mutable checker, printer, method, trailing)
      }
    }
  }
  for (const failure of Arrays.values(checker.failures)) {
    print(failure)
  }
  if (Arrays.length(checker.failures) > 0) {
    return 1
  }
  print(`ok ${Int.toString(checker.count)}`)
  return 0
}

export function run(arguments: Array<string>): int uses io, alloc {
  if (Arrays.length(arguments) == 5 && arguments[1] == "--check") {
    const checkWidth = Int.parse(arguments[2], 10)
    if (checkWidth is Ok(_)) {
      return runCheck(arguments[4], checkWidth.value, arguments[3] != "none")
    }
  }
  let width = 100
  let trailing = true
  let index = 2
  while (index + 1 < Arrays.length(arguments)) {
    if (arguments[index] == "--width") {
      const number = Int.parse(arguments[index + 1], 10)
      if (number is Ok(_)) {
        width = number.value
      }
    } else if (arguments[index] == "--trailing") {
      trailing = arguments[index + 1] != "none"
    }
    index = index + 2
  }
  const read = Fs.readText(arguments[1])
  if (read is Err(message)) {
    print(message)
    return 1
  }
  const parsed = Parser.parseWithTrivia(read.value, 0)
  if (parsed is Err(diagnostic)) {
    print(`error ${Int.toString(diagnostic.pos.line)}:${Int.toString(diagnostic.pos.column)}: ${diagnostic.message}`)
    return 1
  }
  const #[tree, trivia] = parsed.value
  const options = Options { printWidth: width, tabWidth: 2, useTabs: false }
  const printer = Printer {
    source: read.value,
    trivia: trivia,
    settings: Settings { options: options, trailingComma: trailing },
    printExpression: Exprs.printExpression,
    printPattern: Exprs.printPattern,
    printType: Exprs.printType,
    printBlock: printStubBlock,
  }
  const output = Doc.print(printFile(printer, tree), options)
  const written = Fs.writeText("/dev/stdout", output)
  if (written is Err(message)) {
    print(message)
    return 1
  }
  return 0
}
